title: Counter replay prefix
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $B:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1\}\cup\{\text{blank}\}$ be any buffer tape. For every $r\le n$, after $r$ steps from the streaming entry state with input head and both work-tape heads at zero, counter tape of unary length $n$, buffer tape $B$, and empty output, the intercepted maximum-pass machine remains in the streaming entry state; the input and buffer tape are unchanged, the counter head is at $r$, and the output consists of $r$ true bits.
replaced:
For every $r \le n$: from the streaming entry frame with counter length $n$,
exactly $r$ transitions of the intercepted machine copy the first $r$ unary
counter cells to the output, moving only the counter head; no native input or
buffer movement occurs during the replay.
